results.description:
Understanding Catholic Christianity brings students a comprehensive and detailed overview of Catholicism and engages students of all religious and spiritual backgrounds in a meaningful study of the faith tradition that underlies their education at a Catholic high school.

Approachable and Inviting
The course meets 9th grade students where they are and invites them to explore the riches of Catholicism. Compelling narratives and accessible explanations bring theological concepts to life. The design draws in students, and the many review questions and activities help them consider the significance of the course material.

Active Learning
Understanding Catholic Christianity supports active learning by engaging students in discussion, questioning, and exploring. This means that young people will be actively involved in their learning and excited to come to class.

Understanding Catholic Christianity brings energy into the classroom and engages students at every step of the way!
